title: acer pubescens var. genuinum
intro: Acer pubescens var. genuinum, commonly known as the downy paperbark maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Sapindaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
